question: Which agent is said to forcibly cause semen emission of a hundred dalliant women?
premises: He acts upon a hundred dalliant women.
He forcibly causes their semen emission.
inference: The verse identifies a man who forcibly causes semen emission of a hundred dalliant women.
uncertainties: Whether prapātam means emission or falling.
Whether savilāsinīnām is genitive object of retaḥ.
plain_english: A man who by force causes the semen of a hundred dalliant women to be emitted.
